components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled call to action, e.g. Book a 20 minute call.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: #121212; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 16px/24px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2E2E2E; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #121212; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.09); background: transparent; color: #121212; font: 600 16px/24px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F0EFEA; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #121212; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Platform filter for the apps list; selected state inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.09); background: transparent; color: #55534E; font: 500 14px/20px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-chip span { opacity: 0.6; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #121212; background: #F0EFEA; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #121212; color: #FAFAF7; border-color: #121212; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #121212; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: App Card
components.description: Centered sheet for one app: icon, name, tagline, platform tags.
components.html: MMurmurTranscribe audio and video on your Mac.Mac
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; width: 280px; padding: 24px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.09); border-radius: 16px; color: #121212; text-decoration: none; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.2); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #121212; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; background: #7C5CFF; color: #FFFFFF; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font: 600 24px/32px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-card-name { font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-text { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: #55534E; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-tags { display: flex; gap: 4px; justify-content: center; } .ds-tag { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #F0EFEA; color: #55534E; }

components.name: Floating Nav
components.description: Frosted pill nav with name, links and a small booking button.
components.html: Uwe DauernheimAboutCareerAppsFAQBook a call
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); border: 1px solid rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.09); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4); font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-brand { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #121212; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-links a { padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: #55534E; transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: #121212; } .ds-nav-links a[aria-current] { color: #121212; background: #F0EFEA; } .ds-nav-cta { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #121212; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #2E2E2E; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #121212; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ask Field
components.description: Sheet wrapping a borderless textarea and the primary Ask button.
components.css: .ds-ask { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-end; width: 520px; padding: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.09); border-radius: 16px; transition: border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-ask:focus-within { border-color: rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.2); } .ds-ask textarea { flex: 1; resize: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #121212; font: 16px/24px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px; } .ds-ask textarea::placeholder { color: #6F6D67; } .ds-ask button { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 0; background: #121212; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 16px/24px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ask button:hover { background: #2E2E2E; } .ds-ask button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #121212; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Polaroid
components.description: Tilted, taped snapshot with a pen-blue caption; straightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-polaroid { position: relative; width: 148px; margin: 16px; padding: 10px 10px 0; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.45), 0 0 0 1px rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.09); transform: rotate(-4deg); transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-polaroid:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.04); } .ds-polaroid::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -10px; left: 50%; width: 64px; height: 20px; margin-left: -32px; background: rgba(236, 214, 140, 0.6); transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-polaroid-photo { display: block; aspect-ratio: 1; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #E8B07A, #5B6E8C); } .ds-polaroid figcaption { padding: 10px 0 14px; font: 500 14px/20px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2F56C4; text-align: center; }

components.name: Margin Note
components.description: Handwritten aside in pen blue with a drawn arrow. Real notes use PNG masks; this preview stands in with the arrow only.
components.html: ask my old teams, not me
components.css: .ds-note { display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; color: #2F56C4; transform: rotate(-3deg); font: italic 500 18px/24px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-note svg { width: 44px; height: 28px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

narrative.overview:
A working notebook left open on a desk: warm white pages, near-black ink, and the owner's own hand all over it. The printed layer is calm and precise: one Manrope family, a centered single column, generous vertical air, hairline rules. The personal layer sits on top of it: margin notes in pen blue with hand-drawn arrows, a signature that writes itself in, polaroids held on with strips of yellow tape. The two layers never blur. Type and layout stay disciplined so the handwritten artifacts read as genuine asides from a person, not decoration.

Density is low and the rhythm is vertical. Every block sits on the center axis, sections breathe on 96px of padding, and color is almost absent: ink, graphite and pencil greys on paper, with pen blue as the only true hue in the system. Depth comes from paper itself: sheets with hairline borders, and real shadows only on physical objects such as a polaroid or a card you can pick up and swipe.

Light is the only theme today. A dark theme is planned but not designed; see Colors.
keyCharacteristics: Warm white paper, near-black ink, one blue pen.
One typeface (Manrope 400/500/600), tight negative tracking on large headings.
Everything centered on one axis, max 1152px, 680px reading measure.
Handwritten notes, signature, polaroids and tape are the signature motif.
Flat sheets with hairline rules; shadows only on physical objects.
Calm, eased motion (one curve) that wipes, lifts and reveals; all of it respects reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Pen blue belongs to the handwriting. If it isn't written by hand, it isn't blue.

rules.name: The Ink Is the Accent Rule
rules.body: No brand color for buttons or links. Emphasis comes from ink weight and contrast, not hue.

rules.name: Dark Mode Is Open
rules.body: A dark theme is planned but undecided. When it lands it must redefine these same token names on [data-theme="dark"] and keep the notebook metaphor (ink and paper inverted, pen still the only hue). Until then, don't hand-tune one-off dark values.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Manrope only, weights 400, 500 and 600. Never 700+, never a second webfont. Contrast comes from the hand, not a display face.

rules.name: The Balanced Line Rule
rules.body: Headings use text-wrap: balance; paragraphs use text-wrap: pretty.

rules.name: The Objects Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: Only things you could pick up off a desk get a shadow. Interface surfaces stay flat and use rules.

dos: Do keep pen blue (#2F56C4) for handwriting, arrows and polaroid captions only.
Do use ink (#121212) for primary actions and paper/sheet whites for surfaces.
Do center new sections on the page axis with a 680px prose measure and 96px section padding.
Do add handwritten asides, the signature or taped photos to new sections where a personal note genuinely belongs; draw them as masked PNGs in currentColor and wipe them in.
Do use the single easing curve cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) at 300ms (state), 500ms (movement) or 700ms (reveal), and disable movement under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do give every handwriting image a role="img" and an aria-label with the written words.
donts: Don't add a brand accent color, gradients beyond the ink fade on display headings, or colored button fills.
Don't put shadows on flat UI surfaces; only physical objects (swipe cards, polaroids) cast them.
Don't load a second typeface or use Manrope above 600.
Don't fake handwriting with a script font; use real handwriting assets.
Don't left-align a section in isolation; the composition is centered throughout.
Don't ship one-off dark-mode colors before the dark theme is designed.
